title: docs(skills): objectui teaches CEL for bare-string predicates
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DSWGkYzR3Hx2Jbcc8B45cVD)_

domain:skills#2 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4d1Ffw7D64ARzogMukj

Fixes #27587

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`skills/objectui` 里的裸字符串谓词示例全部改成 CEL 写法（`==`、`!=`、`&&`、`!`），运算符清单注明只适用于 `${…}` 模板；指南新增一张 JS → CEL 对照短表；eval 2 改为给出 JS 写法、要求改写成 CEL。
- 为什么改：#27584 合入后，控制台把裸字符串谓词按 CEL 读（和规范、服务端一致），技能还在教 `===` 这类 JS 写法，照抄的 AI 写出的 `hidden` / `visibleWhen` 会出错并把节点藏起来。
- 风险与回滚：只改文档与 eval，无代码、无 schema 变化；回滚即 revert 本 PR。三个文件都在令牌天花板内，没有抬任何一行。
- 先看：`skills/objectui/guides/schema-expressions.md` 的 "Condition fields" 一节（新增的 FROM → TO 清单）。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` 全绿；`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/check-skill-eval-tokens.test.ts` 29/29 通过。
- 需要你做的：本 PR 欠一次契约复审（fable 档，席位负责），落地为 Tier H，需治理审批人批准。

## What changes

- `rules/protocol.md`: the evaluated-fields table shows `"hidden": "data.status == 'draft'"` (was `===`), and the `visibleWhen` row says a bare string is CEL.
- `guides/schema-expressions.md`:
  - The architecture overview says a bare condition string is CEL, evaluated by `@objectstack/formula` as on the server; the recursive-descent parser is named for `${…}` templates only.
  - "Supported operators (full list)" now says it is the `${…}` grammar only.
  - "Condition fields": the bare example is `data.status != 'active'`, and a FROM → TO list follows: `===` / `!==` → `==` / `!=`; `list.includes(x)` → `x in list`, `s.includes('x')` → `s.contains('x')`; `list.length` → `size(list)`; a `data.*` key the scope may lack (`data.x == 1`, `!data.x`, `?.`, `??`) → `has(data.x) && data.x == 1`.
  - The row-predicate bullet says only a `${…}` `condition` still reads on the legacy engine; a bare `===` / `.includes()` faults on CEL.
  - The field-level section no longer says node-level conditions run on `SafeExpressionParser`; troubleshooting item 4 says "a bare CEL string or a `${}` template".
  - Paid down in the same file: the bindable-text-keys paragraph under "What gets expression-evaluated" restated troubleshooting item 1 word for word and is cut.
- `evals/schema-expressions.json`: eval 2 now hands over `"visibleWhen": "data.role === 'admin' && data.status === 'active'"` and expects the CEL rewrite (`must_contain` `CEL` and `status == 'active'`, a token the guide teaches).
- `.changeset/27587-objectui-skill-teaches-cel-predicates.md`: `@objectstack/skills` patch.

## Why

PR #27584 (#27457) made the console read a bare-string predicate as CEL, the way `@objectstack/spec` defines it and the server reads it. Its changeset carries `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, so the skill is where the JavaScript spellings get redirected. Until now the skill taught those spellings, and an agent following it wrote a gate that faulted and hid the node.

## Verification

Each FROM → TO row was measured on the console's `ExpressionEvaluator.evaluateCondition` (built `@objectstack/formula`, `throwOnError` and `onFault`), on this branch's base:

| Spelling | Console reading |
|---|---|
| `data.status === 'draft'` | parse fault, `Unexpected character: =` |
| `data.status == 'draft'` | `true` |
| `data.tags.includes('vip')` / `data.name.includes('urgent')` | runtime fault, `no matching overload for 'dyn.includes(string)'` |
| `'vip' in data.tags` / `data.name.contains('urgent')` | `true` |
| `data.items.length > 0` | runtime fault, `No such key: length` |
| `size(data.items) > 0` / `data.items.size() > 0` | `true` |
| `data.missing == 'x'`, `!data.missing` | runtime fault, `No such key: missing` |
| `has(data.missing)` / `has(data.missing) && data.missing == 'x'` | `false`, no fault |
| `data.missing?.x` / `data.missing ?? 'd'` | parse fault |
| `data.isAuthenticated && data.permissions.canEdit`, `!data.canPerformAction \|\| data.isLocked`, `!data.hasPermission` (the guide's other bare examples) | evaluate, no fault |

The fault policy quoted in the guide ("a visibility gate hides the node, `disabled` disables") is the one `SchemaRenderer`'s `visibilityFaultOutcome` and #27584's changeset state.

Re-grep of `skills/objectui/**`, evals included, for `===`, `!==`, `&&`, `||`, `.includes(`, `.length`: the remaining hits are `${…}` templates (which keep their own grammar), TypeScript / JSX code, or eval `must_not_contain` JSX strings. No other bare predicate uses a JS-only spelling.

Token ratchet (`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`), priced tokens:

| File | Before | After | Ceiling |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `skills/objectui/guides/schema-expressions.md` | 6565 | 6562 | 6571 |
| `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` | 4366 | 4364 | 4368 |
| `skills/objectui/evals/schema-expressions.json` | 536 | 531 | 536 |

No ceiling row moves.

Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives 45 families on this head; all 45 ran locally after a whole-tree `turbo run build` and exited 0; `dispatch-gates --ran` reconciles 45 derived / 45 run / 0 NOT-MEASURED.

Metadata-protocol: none
